scripts.gen: npm run prepare && npm run run:xml:${TARGET} -C ../.. -- --output-dir demos/xml
scripts.build: npm run compile:native:${TARGET} && npm run compile:${TARGET}
scripts.build:kt: npm run compile:interop:native:kt && TARGET=kt npm run build
scripts.compile:interop:native:kt: npm run compile:native-kotlin-host --prefix ../../../external/koala_projects/interop && npm run compile:kotlin:interop --prefix ../../../external/koala_projects/interop
scripts.compile:native: meson setup build/native/${TARGET} -Dtarget=${TARGET} && meson compile -C build/native/${TARGET} && meson install -C build/native/${TARGET}
scripts.all: npm run clean:native && npm run clean:${TARGET} && npm run gen:${TARGET} && npm run build:${TARGET} && npm run exec:${TARGET}
scripts.all:kt: npm run download:koala_projects -C ../../../external && TARGET=kt npm run all
